changelog: Fresh installations now offer automatic public HTTPS for a DNS domain or private HTTPS backed by Caddy's internal CA, both on TCP 443.
Managed installations keep the VoxyWatch backend on loopback and use Caddy for certificates, renewal, compression and HTTP-to-HTTPS redirects.
